statement: The issue-to-PR loop takes a task file (issue spec with choreograph edit ops) and returns a verified pull-request-ready change: cross-file plan -> apply on an isolated worktree -> fixed-point proof -> minimal test selection and execution -> unified diff + pr_intent + Merkle receipt. Golden fixture: rename helper -> compute across 3 files, 6 applied sites, the 1 affected test selected and executed green; run twice, artifacts byte-identical.
